newsitem.title: CHINA: China to give $2.4 mln in aid to North Korea.
newsitem.headline: China to give $2.4 mln in aid to North Korea.

text.p: China agreed on Friday to extend 20 million yuan ($2.4 million) in aid to its famine-stricken neighbour North Korea, the Xinhua news agency said.

Chinese Vice-Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation Liu Shanzai signed a pact on the aid in Pyongyang with North Korea's Vice Chairman of External Economic Commission Kim Munsong, Xinhua said. It gave no more details.

China has so far this year given North Korea some 70,000 tonnes of corn after devastating floods in 1995 and 1996 destroyed large areas of arable land and brought the hermit nation to the brink of famine.
